name: xkcd_panel
about: a small xkcd comic between pages, in xkcd's look: a sheet of the kiosk's dark slides down with its hand-lettered title and alt text, the comic prints in (light on dark, as on the xkcd page), then the sheet slides up off the new page

licence.assets: the xkcd Script font (kiosk/fonts/xkcd-script-subset.ttf, from the IPython xkcd-font project, CC BY-NC 3.0). The comics are fetched from xkcd.com: Randall Munroe's, CC BY-NC 2.5, credited on screen
licence.notes: MIT, running in the OCL v1.1 + SWAtt v1 engine. xkcd's licence is non-commercial: fine on our own kiosks, not on one run for profit
